en.text: Good, you're here. Before the next mission, let me go over the armory with you. Keeping your gear and your ammo in order is my job.
en.description: A man in his early sixties, the old quartermaster of a mining ship, talking to a crew member across the armory counter. Deep, weathered, slightly gravelly voice, worn by years aboard. Calm and grounded, never loud, plain and conversational rather than narrating. Practical and protective, with a dry, understated sense of humor. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Gut, dass du da bist. Lass uns vor der nächsten Mission kurz die Waffenkammer durchgehen. Ich sorge dafür, dass deine Ausrüstung und deine Munition in Ordnung sind.
